= Copilot Instructions for nix-darwin-home
:toc: left
:toclevels: 3
:icons: font
:source-highlighter: rouge

== Project Overview

This is a **Nix-based infrastructure-as-code** repository managing Darwin (macOS) and NixOS systems with Lima VMs, container orchestration (Incus), and Tailscale/Headscale networking. The architecture bridges macOS hosts (alcide, bioskop) with NixOS Lima VMs running RKE2 Kubernetes clusters.

IMPORTANT: **Key architectural pattern**: Development happens in Lima NixOS VMs (not on the macOS host directly). The Darwin configuration is minimal, delegating heavy workloads to virtualized NixOS.

== Architecture & Critical Components

=== Flake Structure (`flake.nix`)

* **`mkHostOutputs`**: Factory function generating both Darwin and NixOS configurations for a host
* **Returns**: `darwinConfiguration`, `nixosConfiguration`, `nixosDiskImage`, `homeManagerConfigurations`
* **Dual-purpose hosts**: Each physical host (alcide, bioskop) has both Darwin config (host OS) and NixOS config (Lima VM)
* **Module composition**: `mkModulesFor` constructs module lists with `preModules`, `baseModules`, `extraModules` layers

=== Host Configuration Pattern (`hosts/*/flake.nix`)

[source,nix]
----
hostProfile = {
  hostName = "APL-dk40njhk9h";  # Physical hostname
  hostAlias = "alcide";          # Human-friendly alias (used as Lima hostname)
  tailnet = { };                 # Tailscale configuration
};
----

* **hostAlias becomes Lima hostname**: `limaHost.hostName` defaults to hostAlias if present
* Profile modules import from `profiles/` (work.nix, committed.nix, common.nix)

=== Module Layering

----
modules/
├── common/        # Shared Darwin + NixOS (primary-user, lima-host, flox, dnsmasq)
├── darwin/        # macOS-specific (lima-config, network-bond, preferences, distributed-builds)
├── nixos/         # Linux-specific (incus, containers, headscale, tailscale, zfs)
└── home-manager/  # User environment (shared across systems)
----

CRITICAL: `modules/common/default.nix` is imported by both Darwin and NixOS. Changes here affect all systems.

=== Lima VM Architecture

* **VM generator**: `modules/darwin/lima-config.nix` creates `~/.lima/<guestName>/lima.yaml`
* **Network management**: `bin/lima-yaml-manager.sh` for surgical YAML edits (preserves user content)
* **Standard networks**: `host`, `bridged`, `shared` (see link:../docs/lima-yaml-management.md[Lima YAML Management])
* **Incus in VM**: NixOS VM runs Incus for container orchestration (not on macOS host)
* **Rebuild workflow**: `darwin-rebuild switch` regenerates Lima configs → restart VM for changes

=== Networking Stack

* **Tailscale**: External access via WireGuard mesh (manual `tailscale up --ssh` on Darwin)
* **Headscale**: Self-hosted Tailscale server for LAN (lower latency, see `modules/nixos/headscale-server.nix`)
* **Gateways**: `incus-tailscale-gateway.nix` advertises subnet routes (e.g., 192.168.106.0/24 for RKE2)
* **SSH**: Both Tailscale and Headscale provide identity-based SSH (replaced Teleport)

==== Network Ranges

[options="header"]
|===
| Network | Range | Purpose
| Lima shared | 192.168.5.0/24 | Lima VM networking
| Incus (alcide) | 192.168.106.0/24 | RKE2 cluster
| Incus (bioskop) | 192.168.107.0/24 | RKE2 cluster
| RKE2 infrastructure | 10.80.0.0/18 | Hierarchical allocation
|===

=== RKE2 Cluster Management (`modules/nixos/incus-rke2-cluster/`)

* **Git subtree**: Standalone repo integrated as subtree (see `.git-subtree-sync.sh`)
* **Makefile-driven**: Hierarchical make targets with layered `rules.mk` files
* **Runtime artifacts**: `.run.d/` directory (gitignored, deterministic regeneration)
** `.run.d/network/` - Network arithmetic exports
** `.run.d/incus/<instance>/` - Cloud-init seeds, preseed YAMLs
* **Key targets**: `ensure-image@incus`, `instance@incus`, `start@cluster`, `stop@cluster`
* **Dual-stack**: Always IPv4+IPv6 (ENABLE_IPV6 toggle removed)

== Development Workflows

=== Rebuilding Darwin (macOS)

[source,bash]
----
# From host directory
cd hosts/alcide  # or hosts/bioskop
darwin-rebuild switch --flake .#alcide
----

* Regenerates Lima VM configs in `~/.lima/`
* Use `--no-networks` flag to skip network management (via `regenerate-lima-config.sh`)

=== Rebuilding NixOS (Lima VM)

[source,bash]
----
# SSH into VM
limactl shell nerd-nixos

# Rebuild from host config
sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake /Users/username/hosts/alcide#alcide-nixos
----

=== RKE2 Cluster Operations

[source,bash]
----
cd modules/nixos/incus-rke2-cluster

# Deploy cluster
make start@cluster CLUSTER_NAME=cluster-1

# Check status
make status@cluster

# Stop cluster
make stop@cluster
----

=== Distributed Builds

* **Local Linux builder**: Automatic via `modules/darwin/linux-builder.nix`
* **Cross-host builds**: `services.crossHostBuilders.enable` (requires Tailscale mesh)
* **Builder keys**: `keys/builder_ed25519` for SSH authentication

== Code Conventions & Patterns

=== @codebase Comments

Files use `@codebase` tags for architectural context:

[source,nix]
----
# NOTE (@codebase): Rollback instructions:
#   - Remove "ca-derivations" from experimental-features.
#   - Set auto-optimise-store = true to restore inline dedup.
----

IMPORTANT: **Purpose**: Mark critical decisions, migration paths, and invariants. Preserve when editing.

=== mkDefault vs mkForce

* **mkDefault**: Allows flake-level overrides (e.g., `limaHost.hostName` in `lima-host.nix`)
* **mkForce**: Overrides all other priorities (use sparingly, e.g., `networking.hostName`)

=== Profile System

[source,nix]
----
# profiles/work.nix
profile.user.name = "work-username";
profile.homeSymlinks = [ "committed" ];  # Cross-profile home directory access
----

* **User mapping**: `userMapping.profileUsers.{work, committed}` in `profiles/common.nix`
* **UID/GID**: Work profile uses 503:503 (see `profiles/work.nix`)

=== Module Options Pattern

[source,nix]
----
options.services.myService = {
  enable = mkEnableOption "My Service";
  serverUrl = mkOption { type = types.str; description = "..."; };
};

config = mkIf cfg.enable {
  # Implementation
};
----

=== Overlays (`overlays/`)

* **Applied in flake.nix**: `pkgsFor` extends basePackages with custom overlays
* **Convention**: `<name>Overlay = inputs: import ./overlays/<name>.nix inputs;`
* **Examples**: `qemuOverlay`, `birdOverlay`, `incusComposeOverlay`

== Testing & Validation

=== Nix Build Commands

[source,bash]
----
# Check flake
nix flake check

# Build Darwin config
nix build .#darwinConfigurations.alcide.system

# Build NixOS disk image
nix build .#nixosDiskImage

# Validate closure size
nix path-info -Sh result
----

=== Pre-commit Validation

* **Format**: Uses `treefmt-nix` (see flake inputs)
* **Lint**: No explicit linters configured (Nix evaluation catches syntax errors)

=== Makefile Validation (RKE2)

[source,bash]
----
# Dry-run
make --dry-run start@cluster

# Validate includes
make validate@includes  # (planned target)

# List runtime artifacts
ls -la .run.d/
----

== Documentation Standards

=== AsciiDoc Convention

* **Primary format**: `.adoc` files in `docs/` (not Markdown)
* **Key docs**: `docs/README.adoc`, `docs/modules-reference.adoc`, `docs/runtime-layout.adoc`
* **Session notes**: `docs/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD.adoc` (see link:../docs/collaboration-guide.adoc[Collaboration Guide])

=== Session Workflow

. **Pre-session**: Update `docs/NEXT-SESSION-TODO.adoc`
. **During**: Create `docs/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD.adoc` with achievements
. **Pre-expiration**: AI reminder at T-5m to finalize summary
. **Closure**: Update `docs/sessions/README.adoc` with latest session link

=== Module Documentation Pattern

See link:../docs/modules-reference.adoc[Modules Reference]:

* Options table with types and defaults
* Management scripts (`deploy-*`, `*-status`, `*-shell`)
* Example configurations
* Troubleshooting section

== Common Pitfalls

=== ❌ Don't: Edit `.run.d/` directly

Generated files - modify source templates or Makefile logic instead.

=== ❌ Don't: Use `mkForce` without justification

Breaks composition. Prefer `mkDefault` and `mkOverride` for priority management.

=== ❌ Don't: Assume Darwin == NixOS

Check `pkgs.stdenvNoCC.isDarwin` for platform-specific logic.

=== ❌ Don't: Mix Markdown in docs/

Use AsciiDoc (`.adoc`) for consistency with existing documentation.

=== ✅ Do: Preserve @codebase comments

These document architectural decisions and migration paths.

=== ✅ Do: Use lima-yaml-manager.sh for network changes

Preserves user customizations (see link:../docs/lima-yaml-management.md[Lima YAML Management]).

=== ✅ Do: Test both Darwin and NixOS builds

Both configurations are generated from same host flake.

[options="header"]
|===
| File | Purpose
| `flake.nix` | Main flake (1000+ lines, factory functions)
| `hosts/alcide/flake.nix` | Darwin entry for alcide host
| `hosts/bioskop/flake.nix` | Darwin entry for bioskop host
| `modules/{darwin,nixos,common}/default.nix` | Module indices
| `modules/darwin/lima-config.nix` | VM generation logic
| `modules/nixos/headscale-server.nix` | Self-hosted VPN server
| `modules/nixos/incus-rke2-cluster/Makefile` | RKE2 cluster orchestration
| `docs/collaboration-guide.adoc` | AI session protocol
|===

== Shell Environment

* **Default shell**: `zsh` (configured in `modules/common/default.nix`)
* **Home Manager**: Manages shell config, user packages (`.zshrc`, `.bashrc`)
* **Lima VM shell**: `limactl shell <vm-name>` or `ssh lima-<hostname>`

== External Dependencies

[options="header"]
|===
| Dependency | Purpose
| Cachix | Binary cache (`nxmatic.cachix.org`)
| Flox | Environment management (from `flake-commons`)
| Socket VMNet | macOS VM networking
| Incus | Container orchestration (replaces LXD)
|===

== Quick Reference

=== Common Commands

[source,bash]
----
# Darwin rebuild
cd hosts/alcide && darwin-rebuild switch --flake .#alcide

# NixOS rebuild (in VM)
sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake /path/to/config

# Lima VM management
limactl start nerd-nixos
limactl shell nerd-nixos
limactl stop nerd-nixos

# RKE2 cluster
make start@cluster CLUSTER_NAME=cluster-1
make status@cluster
make stop@cluster

# Network diagnostics
tailscale status
hs-status
----
